QuestInfo.name: Learn to Combo
QuestInfo.0: Someone with a clear and strong voice calls to you. Who could it be?
QuestInfo.1: Someone with a clear and strong voice calls to you. Who could it be?
QuestInfo.2: You have learned about linked attacks from Hawkeye, the Chief Knight of the Thunder Breakers.

0.0: Why, 'ello there, mate! #h0#, right? I'm #p1101007#, ol' captain of the Thunder Breakers. I must say, it is the epitome of delight to make yer acquaintance. \r\n#L0##bYou're awfully nice for a pirate.#l\n#k
0.1: Heh, just because I swashbuckle don't mean I can't mind me 'please's and 'thank you's. Now would ye oblige this ol' sailor by listenin' to an explanation of #e#rLinked Attacks#n#k? \r\n#L0##bSure. Explain away!#l\n#k
0.2: It sounds real fancy-like, but the term just means ye can use yer next attack skill even before yer prior one finishes. \r\n#L0##bOh, that's neat.#l\n#k
0.3: Aye. There'll be less time between skills, which means #bye'll be attackin' more quickly#k. This system also lets ye keep #bStance#k up. A good defense is the best offense, as they say. Also, if ye learn the #bChain#k skill, yer attacks'll do more damage.

yes.0: Sharp one, aren't ye? Thanks for listenin' to me ramble on. I wish ye the best in yer adventures. I'll be watchin' from afar.

no.0: I must not be explainin' meself well. Let me try again...
